body: 2020–2024 rewarded policy-driven capex themes (PLI, China+1, defence, railways, power/capital goods, EMS) and financialisation; by late 2025–2026 valuations compressed in parts of the market. As of mid-Nov 2026 the Nifty 50 trades around 20–21x trailing earnings, midcaps near their 10-yr forward average, and small caps still at a premium to their own history.
